summary: Fresh work-list retries pin their first requested publication cut so ongoing writes cannot keep moving the command's freshness target

compatibility.detail: Current work first pages accept min_cut, bounded by the current host-local store index. Fresh clients retain the first not-fresh wanted_cut across retries; clients without min_cut retain per-request freshness. Older daemons without wanted_cut remain supported. Debug work-publication fold logs report cut lag and fold duration.
